title: Scaffold browser runtime and project verification
acceptance: a TypeScript + Vite browser application builds and opens with a Three.js scene using a WebGL2-compatible rendering baseline
Rapier 3D/WASM is initialized behind a small physics boundary without coupling game logic directly to package bootstrap details
action-based keyboard input exposes steer, throttle, brake/reverse, handbrake, and reset actions even if vehicle behavior is still placeholder
package scripts provide deterministic typecheck/test/build checks and .agent/VERIFY.json is updated so quick verification includes product-aware checks
third-party runtime dependencies are pinned and their licenses are recorded or mechanically discoverable for later attribution review
